scope: LightGlue post-match 2D verification; no temporal compensation, BA, online tracking, commit or push
cache: V19 shared RootSIFT and LightGlue full 2D matches
depth: Original V19 source-only sample_depth eligibility; scale5000; no time warp

fundamental.input: all cached LightGlue 2D matches before depth filtering

subset_controls: Uniform without replacement from V19 original source-depth-valid rows, same count as F_MAGSAC eligible rows; original source-index order; retain all three controls
undefined_control: If verification fails and no valid cardinality exists, label control unavailable and return exact raw pose; retain pair in denominator
native_pnp: Unchanged V19 binary and parameters, requested seed17; no claim that global seeds vary legacy local sampler
verification_randomness: Requested OpenCV global seed17, record implementation behavior; one fixed F/H configuration, no claim of independent trials from global seed setting
fallback: Exact raw transform for every failure, with separate verification/support/native/process reasons
evaluation: GT only after fit seal; both nearest and interpolated alignment must pass3cm/2deg; preserve every negative outcome
advance: Accuracy above15 and damage below7 relative to V19, with value beyond typical equal-count controls; explicitly compare against V20 tradeoff16 accurate/3 damaged/3 original benefits retained
